topic: V17 producer-bound exact execution/outcome/GWT causal support and restart recovery

baseline_negative.claim: Caller-supplied non-empty episode_id/signal_id/causal_id are correlation labels, not sufficient durable causal ancestry.

hypothesis: V17 terminalization is admissible only when it consumes producer-admitted immutable support derived from a coherent pre-existing execution, exact verified effect outcome, GWT receiver-use, prediction and direct causal-credit history; the terminal consumer must not mint the support it proves.
strongest_counterhypothesis: Full causal closure could be too strict for legitimate crash reconciliation when exact execution/outcome evidence survives but historical GWT/prediction support is unavailable; full-process failover remains required before promotion beyond candidate status.

fresh_primary_evidence.relevance: Valid provenance is constrained by uniqueness, event ordering and impossible histories; identifier presence alone is not a sufficient valid provenance history.

trace-id and parent-id identify propagated trace/request context and caller-supplied flags are not strict authority; this supports treating caller identifiers as correlation context rather than causal authorization.
Current fixed lineage includes the WAL-reset corruption fix; target V17 run below still used system SQLite 3.45.1 and therefore does not clear the separate production storage blocker.

ordinary_repairs_before_target_execution.change: Align stale workflow scope assertion with executed restart test scope.
Replace actions/checkout with manual exact-SHA checkout attempt in persistent GITHUB_WORKSPACE.
Move exact-SHA checkout and all execution into isolated /tmp repository, remove remote after fetch, assert exact head and no residual remote.

go_oob_experiment.name: CROSS_CHAIN_SUPPORT_SPLICE
go_oob_experiment.setup: Two independently producer-admitted exact-outcome support chains target the same verified V14 effect/outcome but belong to different workspace cycles; the intervention splices GWT/use from chain A with causal credit from chain B.

fusion.causal_model_delta: Promote producer-bound relational ancestry as the preferred V17 re-entry mechanism candidate; reject caller-provided IDs, correlated-only credit, broken receiver closure, wrong-subject prediction and cross-cycle chain splices.
fusion.storage_interaction: NO_CONTRADICTION_WITH_SQLITE_BLOCKER: this V17 run used system SQLite 3.45.1 but did not execute the high-contention WAL-reset falsifier. Its per-test integrity checks passing do not establish production storage safety. Compose/re-run V17 on the admitted private fixed SQLite 3.53.4 runtime before production promotion.
fusion.recovery_interaction: Component close/reopen plus release of original execution is supported; full-process failover/crash recovery remains unmeasured for this V17 candidate.

next_frontier: Run PR280 V17 candidate through the admitted hash-pinned private SQLite 3.53.4 path and preserve exact runtime provenance.
Add full-process crash/failover recovery around producer-admitted support, not merely component close/reopen.
Bind the producer/terminal path into the production non-bypass self.root effect path before canonical promotion.
Retain PR317 as a permanent negative regression so caller-supplied causal labels cannot regain authority.
